question.worked_solution:
To add or subtract complex numbers, we add or subtract their real parts, and we add or subtract their imaginary parts.

In this case, $-5\,\text{i}$ and $8\,\text{i}$ are purely imaginary numbers. Therefore, we only need to add their imaginary parts, as follows:

$$
-5\,\text{i}-8\,\text{i}=(-5-8)\,\text{i}=-13\,\text{i}
$$
